_README: Dev-only extra permissions, applied by tools/dev-grants.mjs as the last step
of `npm run dev:refresh` (TEAM-WORKFLOW.md §3). NEVER applied to production —
the tool refuses by project ref, not by hoping the caller passed the right env.
WHAT THIS IS FOR: a guest reviewer who needs to SEE one feature for a week
without becoming an administrator of the live system. The team itself does not
need it — D3 settled that a real ทีม SAMO seat is fine for them.
WHY IT WRITES `permissions` AND NOT `managed_permissions`: on every login,
sync_my_team_permissions() rewrites every managed_* column from the team
registry, so a grant written there is erased the next time the person signs
in — silently. current_user_has_permission() reads the UNION of both columns,
so `permissions` grants the same access and survives.
EVERY ENTRY MUST EXPIRE. `until` is a plain YYYY-MM-DD. Past that date the
tool SKIPS the entry and says so loudly at every refresh — this list will rot
like every list of people, and the only defence is making the rot visible.
